concepts.gloss_en: a stillbirth/miscarried fetus — metaphor for the false-famous leaders (מפרסמים) who emerge before their time

members.note: plural of same noun; both from lm2:20 in the same 'miscarriage/premature ones' image (יצאו ילדיה / נעשין קודם זמנם) — same concept, number difference only

notes: Singular/plural of the same concept within one Torah (lm2:20). Merged as 'likely' since number is the only difference and the referent (premature/stillborn = the prematurely-arising famous ones) is identical.
